fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Downloaded from the publisher product page https://www.lookout-spiele.de/en/games/omg.html. The publisher product page dates the base game to 2015 and links English rules V1.5 used by the rule record; the 3D box is the base game, not the later Big Box. Reduced to 274 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently worked the hardest becomes the first active player, or choose a player at random.
clarifications: The active player handles the Sunrise phase and deals cards; players then act in active-player order.
The active-player role passes clockwise at the end of each round.
